deposit_routed_through_preview_mint.meaning: a deposit was processed through the vault's previewMint path

preview_withdraw_reverted.meaning: the ERC4626-style previewWithdraw call reverted while computing share amounts for an asset-based withdrawal

assumptions: The deposit routed through previewMint precedes the asset-based previewWithdraw call in the reported scenario.
previewWithdraw is invoked to compute share amounts before an asset-based withdrawal.

unresolved.description: The report does not state whether the previewWithdraw revert requires the prior previewMint-routed deposit or occurs unconditionally; the intent is stated unconditionally while the only precondition is the conditional deposit.

limitations: The intent is treated as an unconditional no-revert requirement on previewWithdraw; the deposit precondition is retained as the reported scenario context rather than a narrowing of the requirement.
No concrete numeric deposit amount or state walk is bound; the revert is represented as a report-stated observable outcome.
